title: Competitive Scouting Decision Graph and Procurement Trigger Playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a decision graph that maps model-landscape signals (availability, latency, cost, quant compatibility, legal/region constraints) to procurement and rollout actions for Dedicated/Private offerings. Deliverables: signal taxonomy, scoring rules, alert thresholds, and an automation spec for procurement triggers.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Decision graph covers top 12 model suppliers and 4 regional markets. 2) Alert rules expressed as deterministic scoring equations. 3) Integration stub that emits alerts to a Slack channel and provisions an internal procurement ticket. 4) Runbook documented in Confluence with example incidents.
research_plan: 1) Collect latency/cost traces from runtime-telemetry and benchmark lab. 2) Cross-reference license/region restrictions with legal intake. 3) Interview 3 enterprise customers about fallback tolerance. 4) Validate scoring thresholds with simulation on historical incidents.
risks: incomplete telemetry from legacy Dedicated clusters
mitigations: start with conservative thresholds and require two signal tiers
add manual approval step for >$X monthly commits
next_steps: Create initial signal taxonomy doc (owner: Aisha)
Prototype scoring functions in Python notebook (owner: Luca)
Schedule legal sync on region licensing (owner: Daniel)
Build Slack alert prototype and procurement ticket template (owner: Priya)
